title: Public local forgot-password
summary: Local public accounts can request a password reset from Public Login. Directory and Cloudron accounts continue to use Staff Login and Cloudron.
changes: Add guest forgot-password and reset-password pages for local service-user accounts, linked from Public Login.
Send a reset email only for eligible local public accounts; directory, Cloudron, pending first-login, and staff-eligible accounts receive the same generic confirmation without a reset mail.
Set username, current-password, and new-password autocomplete hints on public login, register, forgot-password, and reset fields.
version_rationale: Minor release: adds a guest password-recovery path for local public accounts without changing Cloudron directory sign-in.
validation: PHPUnit PublicLocalForgotPasswordTest covers local public reset versus directory, Cloudron, pending first-login, hybrid, and staff refusal, plus expired tokens and autocomplete hints.
Related public auth tests remain green. No impersonation control is present, and reset values are not stored in audit history.
Ran php artisan myapes:changelog-validate against the admin local public password reset parent branch for this stacked change.
known_limitations: Signed-in profile change-password remains a separate change. Directory and Cloudron passwords continue to be managed in Cloudron.
rollback: Redeploy the previous application version. Passwords already changed through this flow remain in effect until the account holder or an administrator sets a new password.
provenance: Defined by the public local forgot-password task for MyAPES Account issue #121 under epic #158 and pull request #161.
